newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Largest capitalisation firms lift Moroccan bourse.
newsitem.headline: Largest capitalisation firms lift Moroccan bourse.

text.p: The Casablanca stock market ended the session on Thursday higher due mainly to active trading of the market's largest capitalisation companies, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 427.41 points, up 0.56 percent.
"The stock market followed the previous trend and remained non-liquid...Securities were not available for the investors' rising demand," Sanae Bennouna, a stockbroker at Upline Securities, said.
The index surge is due to trading of the market heavy weights Wafabank, Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, Societe Nationale d'Investissement and Eqdomn credit company, Bennouna said.
EQDOM, one the largest consumer credit company jumped to 989 dirhams, up 59 dirhams on the previous session.
Wafabank gained 14 dirhams to close at 498 dirhams.
SNI, one of the market blue chips, rose five dirhams to close at 585.
BMCE, a very liquid stock and one of the largest banks, closed at 420, up four dirhams compared with Wednesday's session.
The bourse traded volume rose to 71.8 million dirhams from 56.3 million dirhams on Wednesday.
